_comment: "Return an ALLY from your graveyard TO THE ARENA." It was RETURN_DR_FROM_GRAVEYARD, which returns a DEFENSE REACTION card to HAND -- wrong card type and wrong destination, and target_zone:'ALLY' was the only hint. SEARCH_GRAVEYARD is the may-fail-to-find graveyard search and now takes a destination and matches SUBTYPES, which is what 'Ally' is. Earlier: was a DESTROY_TOKEN naming no token at all, so it destroyed nothing; 'destroy IT' means the ally this card returned, and a ref cannot cross into a delayed trigger in another ability -- reference scopes are per ability execution -- so that half is APPROXIMATED as an Ally you control. The 'discard your hand' half was DISCARD with amount 0, so the whole downside of the card was absent.
